goal: The git-worktree worker records each active phase's base commit SHA at phase entry (a committed .loop-base file in the phase dir), and flywheel.workflow exposes a helper returning that phase's cumulative git diff versus the recorded base.

references: .workflow/worker.py:646 (_phase_base) -- the worker runs on a base branch and FF-merges flywheel/<phase>/<task> into it; by archive time the phase's commits are already in the base, so the base SHA must be captured at phase entry, not derived at archive.
.workflow/worker.py commit_task_files / run_once -- capture the base right after task files are committed, before any task merges.
src/flywheel/workflow.py:1114 (archive_completed_phases) -- the consumer of the diff helper (next task wires it in).
tests/test_worker.py:334 (test_run_once_merges_completed_task) -- model for a real-git-repo test.
constraints: Record the base as a committed `.loop-base` file (the current HEAD SHA) inside active/<phase>/ the first time the worker processes the phase; never overwrite an existing .loop-base (the first-seen SHA is the true base).

Put the reusable logic (write-base-if-missing, diff-vs-base) in flywheel.workflow so it is testable without the worker; the worker only calls it. File/git I/O belongs in the workflow layer, never in flywheel.task/flywheel.lifecycle -- do not weaken either purity test.

The diff helper returns the unified-diff text of `git diff <base-sha> HEAD` for the repo; when a phase has no recorded .loop-base it must degrade safely to an empty diff (return empty string), not raise.

.loop-base is a dotfile: confirm archive_completed_phases' task-file iteration already skips dot-prefixed and non-.json entries so it is never treated as a task (workflow.py:1124-1132 already filters these) -- add a test asserting a phase with only a .loop-base plus done tasks still archives.
Add a test in tests/test_workflow.py (real git repo) asserting (a) base capture writes the pre-merge SHA once and is idempotent, and (b) the diff helper returns the phase's added lines.
Run mcp__ide__getDiagnostics on every .py file you touch and fix all Pylance errors before reporting verify.
Commit the change with a Conventional Commits message (feat: ...) before emitting intent=verify.
non_goals: Do not add the marker or the archive gate (separate tasks).
Do not ever read, write, or diff the production .workflow/flywheel.sqlite.
edge_cases: Two phases entering in the same cycle each get their own .loop-base; capture is per-phase-dir.
A re-run after .loop-base already exists must not move the recorded base forward.
